overview_description.description: Built for collaboration and created with modern teams in mind, Pitch is changing how presentations are crafted and knowledge is shared. With a focus on real-time communication, smart workflows, and customizable templates, Pitch makes it easy for teams to work together to develop beautiful presentations. That’s why brands like Slack, Framer, and MetaLab love using Pitch. Founded by the team that created Wunderlist, Pitch has raised $50 million in funding since its founding in 2018.
